brief:
Hamas official Majed Abu Qateesh called on Jerusalem residents to confront Israeli occupation crimes in the city, including demolition operations targeting Palestinian facilities and homes, Shehab Wire reported. Abu Qateesh stressed the necessity of mounting active resistance to these demolition campaigns.

The appeal underscores escalating tensions over Israeli demolition operations in Jerusalem. Palestinian structures, including residential buildings and public installations, have faced repeated destruction as part of ongoing Israeli policies in the occupied city. Abu Qateesh's call reflects Hamas efforts to mobilize grassroots opposition to what Palestinian leaders describe as systematic dismantling of Palestinian infrastructure and displacement of residents.
